## feature

None

## fix

### mixed naming convention in output values and columns

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

A grep proves the pre-change state: every column name was snake_case and the length-dist metric values (`read_len`, `dm`) were snake_case, while the AP values/columns were PascalCase — `ap_Both` was a mixed-convention column name.

#### description

```
type: [table, text]
```

1. AP values: `Both`/`StartOnly`/`EndOnly`/`Neither` → `both`/`start_only`/`end_only`/`neither` on all three surfaces (tag value, `--ap-stats` types, qc-summary columns).
2. TC value: `OnTarget` → `on_target`.
3. qc-summary columns: `ap_Both`… → `ap_both`/`ap_start_only`/`ap_end_only`/`ap_neither`.

#### before

The same output family mixed PascalCase enum values with snake_case column names and snake_case metric values.

#### after

Every value and column across all outputs follows one snake_case convention.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

- `src/sam_tagger/processing.py:242-267` — `check_amplicon_primers` returns the snake_case values (single source).
- `src/sam_tagger/stats/qc_summary.py:50-53,92-100,125-128` — schema keys, match arms, appends.
- `src/sam_tagger/stats/tag_stats.py:79` — ap-stats type list.
- `src/sam_tagger/lib.py` — TC `"on_target"`; `src/sam_tagger/cli.py` help texts.
- Post-change grep: no enum PascalCase remains in `src/` or `docs/usage.qmd` (the English word "Both" in a pileup comment is prose, not the enum).

:::

## limitation

### old tagged BAMs carry old values forever

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

The rename changes what new runs write; existing files are not rewritten.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. qc-summary is unaffected by old BAMs — it recomputes and never reads tags.
2. Consumers joining OLD tagged BAMs with NEW stats files must translate the four AP values and `OnTarget` once.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

- `src/sam_tagger/lib.py` `run_qc_summary` — recomputation path (established in the 2026-10-20 assessment).

:::

## caveat

### downstream filters on old spellings fail silently

```
level: high
```

#### reason

Structural: a filter like `type == "Both"` returns empty rows, not an error.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. Pipelines consuming the AP tag value, the TC tag value, `--ap-stats` types, or the qc-summary `ap_*` columns must grep for the PascalCase forms before upgrading.
2. The commit message carries the full migration table; the next release note must repeat it.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

- Commit `c968490` body — the BREAKING CHANGE migration table.

:::
